name: Flattened Gaussian Ellipsoid Rendering
definition: A technique to approximate 2D Gaussian ellipses (surface-like representations) by flattening the 3D Gaussian ellipsoids.
summary: Flattened Gaussian Ellipsoid Rendering stabilizes surface-like volume rendering by flattening 3D Gaussian ellipsoids into zero-determinant kernels, differing from standard splatting by enforcing this constraint.
